*   SetUserAgentAIAgent must be an exported function in the httpstate client package that accepts an AI agent name string and stores it as package-level state. *   SetUserAgentCommand must sanitize the input value: leading and trailing whitespace is stripped, spaces and tabs are replaced with hyphens, and parentheses '(' ')' and semicolons ';' are removed. For example, 'weird (cmd; with) bits' must become 'weird-cmd-with-bits'.

134	// addPulumiCLIMetadataToEnvironment enriches updates with metadata to provide context about
135	// the system, environment, and options that an update is being performed with.
136	func addPulumiCLIMetadataToEnvironment(env map[string]string, flags *pflag.FlagSet, getEnviron func() []string) {
137		// Pulumi Environment Variables (Name and Set/Truthiness Only)
138	
139		// Set up a map of all known bool environment variables.
140		boolVars := map[string]struct{}{}
141		for _, e := range declared.Variables() {
142			_, ok := e.Value.(declared.BoolValue)
143			if !ok {
144				continue
145			}
146			boolVars[e.Name()] = struct{}{}
147		}
148	
149		// Add all environment variables that start with "PULUMI_" and their set-ness or truthiness.
150		for _, envvar := range getEnviron() {
151			if !strings.HasPrefix(envvar, "PULUMI_") {
152				// Not a Pulumi environment variable. Skip.
153				continue
154			}
155			name, value, ok := strings.Cut(envvar, "=")
156			if !ok {
157				// Invalid environment variable. Skip.
158				continue
159			}
160			flag := "set"
161			if _, isBoolVar := boolVars[name]; isBoolVar {
162				flag = "false"
163				if cmdutil.IsTruthy(value) {
164					flag = "true"
165				}
166			}
167	
168			// Only store the variable name and set-ness or truthiness not the value.
169			env["pulumi.env."+name] = flag
170		}
171	
172		// System information
173		env["pulumi.version"] = version.Version
174		env["pulumi.os"] = runtime.GOOS
175		env["pulumi.arch"] = runtime.GOARCH
176	
177		// Guard against nil pointer dereference.
178		if flags == nil {
179			// No command was provided. Don't add flags.
180			return
181		}
182	
183		// Pulumi CLI Flags (Name Only)
184		flags.Visit(func(f *pflag.Flag) {
185			env["pulumi.flag."+f.Name] = func() string {
186				truth, err := flags.GetBool(f.Name)
187				switch {
188				case err != nil:
189					return "set" // not a bool flag
190				case truth:
191					return "true"
192				default:
193					return "false"
194				}
195			}()
196		})
197	}

199	// addCIMetadataToEnvironment populates the environment metadata bag with CI/CD-related values.
200	func addCIMetadataToEnvironment(env map[string]string) {
201		// Add the key/value pair to env, if there actually is a value.
202		addIfSet := func(key, val string) {
203			if val != "" {
204				env[key] = val
205			}
206		}
207	
208		// Use our built-in CI/CD detection logic.
209		vars := ciutil.DetectVars()
210		if vars.Name == "" {
211			return
212		}
213		env[backend.CISystem] = string(vars.Name)
214		addIfSet(backend.CIBuildID, vars.BuildID)
215		addIfSet(backend.CIBuildNumer, vars.BuildNumber)
216		addIfSet(backend.CIBuildType, vars.BuildType)
217		addIfSet(backend.CIBuildURL, vars.BuildURL)
218		addIfSet(backend.CIPRHeadSHA, vars.SHA)
219		addIfSet(backend.CIPRNumber, vars.PRNumber)
220	}

## Summary

**`pkg/backend/httpstate/client/api.go`**
- Added package-level state (`userAgentCommand`, `userAgentAIAgent`) guarded by a `sync.RWMutex`.
- `SetUserAgentCommand(command string)` — sanitizes the input (trims whitespace, replaces spaces/tabs with hyphens, strips `(`, `)`, `;`) and stores it. `'weird (cmd; with) bits'` → `'weird-cmd-with-bits'`. Empty string clears it.
- `SetUserAgentAIAgent(agent string)` — stores the agent name verbatim; empty clears it.
- `UserAgent()` now builds `pulumi-cli/1 (<version>; <os>[; cmd=<value>][; agent=<value>])`. With no extras it matches `^pulumi-cli/1 \([^()]*\)$` and contains neither `cmd=` nor `agent=`. When both are set, `cmd` precedes `agent` (`...; cmd=<value>; agent=<value>)`).
